limits: Unloaded straight wing, independently reconstructed material table, not original published ASWING input.
Empirical ASWING lag is not exact Theodorsen aerodynamics.
Independent Hermite bending fields differ from production endpoint interpolation.
Local native searches do not establish the complete native finite spectrum.
No loaded Case4 flutter, general convergence, experimental agreement, or complete ASWING feature claim.

numerical_scaling.state: x=[Omega*q, v, sqrt(rho*delta_s)*Gamma] for mass-normalized mechanics; Gamma unchanged at rho=0

numerical_scaling.history: Initial unscaled WASM mismatch, original spectra, neutral-scaling diagnostics and successful diagnostic WASM replay preserved in candidate-history/conditioning-evidence.zip
